잠언 31:1.content: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.

잠언 31:2.content: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?

잠언 31:3.content: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.

잠언 31:4.content: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:

잠언 31:5.content: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.

잠언 31:6.content: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.

잠언 31:7.content: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

잠언 31:8.content: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.

잠언 31:9.content: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.

잠언 31:10.content: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.

잠언 31:11.content: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.

잠언 31:12.content: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.

잠언 31:13.content: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.

잠언 31:14.content: She is like the merchants’ ships; she bringeth her food from afar.

잠언 31:15.content: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.

잠언 31:16.content: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.

잠언 31:17.content: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.

잠언 31:18.content: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.

잠언 31:19.content: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.

잠언 31:20.content: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.

잠언 31:21.content: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

잠언 31:22.content: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.

잠언 31:23.content: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.

잠언 31:24.content: She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.

잠언 31:25.content: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.

잠언 31:26.content: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.

잠언 31:27.content: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.

잠언 31:28.content: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.

잠언 31:29.content: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.

잠언 31:30.content: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the Lord, she shall be praised.

잠언 31:31.content: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
